text_block_list.text: —I couldn't believe my eyes.

I arrived at the classroom to look for Sirius Symboli.
Due to a certain reason, I had braced myself
for an awkward, tense atmosphere, but...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Fufu, yes. I quite like that place too.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Ha, look who gets it!
Then that part too...
They're talking. The two who were the very source of the tension are conversing so cheerfully...!
choice_data_list: (Just what kind of conversation...)

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
So, you came to ask me directly?
You're way too honest for your own good.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Well, good boy.
You act because you want to know. Smart, I like it.
choice_data_list: Thanks for the compliment...
Thank you for praising me...

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Well, good girl.
You act because you want to know. Smart, I like it.
choice_data_list: Thanks for the compliment...
Thank you for praising me...

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
—And here's the answer to your question.
It's a story about a man who destroyed the world for his sister.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
The man had a precious younger sister with a big age gap.
Yet she was persecuted at school for a petty reason—

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Her world was closed off entirely.
...The man harbored deep hatred toward those who broke his sister.
And so, while cradling her, he spoke—

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"I'll destroy them... Just as they did, I will eradicate them...
Every single last one of them...!"

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
“The parents who gave birth to them, the grandparents who spoiled them,
the siblings who laughed, the useless pet who never realized their true nature,
the friends who didn't stop them, the lover who egged them on—”

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"The neighbors who acted goody-two-shoes, the clerk made to feel good about himself.
Everything that gave them wisdom and arrogance.
Everything that brought them heartlessness and incompetence...!"

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"Everything! Everything, everything, everything, everything, everything, everything!
I'll destroy everything!!"
choice_data_list: I-Isn't that going a little too far...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Phew...

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Heh heh, that's precisely why you're still just a little puppy.
choice_data_list: Huh, don't you two think you're overdoing it?
Wait, don't you two think that's going a bit too far?

text_block_list.name: Sirius & Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Not at all.
No.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"Abandoning even ethics and morality for the sake of one's goals.
Isn't that just an adorable kind of madness, huh?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: I agree.
choice_data_list: I see... You two really get along well.
I see... You two really hit it off, huh?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: We get along relatively well in conversation, I suppose.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
When all's said and done, yeah.
...Oh, hey, do you remember? Back then—

text_block_list.name: VIP
text_block_list.text: Therefore, to those of you who will run today's race, I ask that you honor history and the hoofprints of the predecessors who carved it, and give your all for the sake of future Umamusume as well...—

text_block_list.name: The Two in Their Childhood
text_block_list.text:
—How boring.
—What a bore.

text_block_list.name: Young Sirius
text_block_list.text:
"Like hell I'd run for history or for someone else.
...I run for my own brilliance!"

text_block_list.name: Young Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Yes. Having just one place for love to rest is more than enough.

text_block_list.name: Young Sirius
text_block_list.text: ...Huh, we actually get along surprisingly well. Nice, let's head inside and chat.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Oh yes, that did happen, didn't it.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Ha, you've always been crazy.
And that's just what I like about you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Heheh, how innocent. I wonder just how many people you've bewitched with that childlike passion?
choice_data_list: (――I, see.)

text_block_list.text:
These two are utterly pure.
Purely and relentlessly chasing their desires.

"That is likely why the novel's protagonist is so endearing.
The way he acts purely out of love for his sister."
choice_data_list: You two have a great relationship.
You two have a nice relationship.
You two make a great pair.
You make a nice duo.

text_block_list.text:
"That is likely why the novel's protagonist is so endearing.

choice_data_list: You two have a great relationship.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Hmph. Don't really get what's so great about it, but hey, it's easy enough.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
You're right.
Neither of us asks anything of the other, after all.
choice_data_list: O-Oh, I see...

text_block_list.text:
Seeing her reply with such utter disinterest,
I felt a strange sense of familiarity.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"A duo, huh... In that case, wouldn't
Lord 'Emperor' be a better fit for this one?"

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
You guys probably have
plenty of chances to chat anyway.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: ...Is that so?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Ghk... Hahaha! Cold as ice, aren't you?
Even the great "Emperor" loses face here!
